Elias read it twice, pressed the paper flat, and placed it in the keeper’s log beside the names of all the lights that still burned.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市还浸在深蓝色的梦里。街灯沿着潮湿的马路延伸，把光晕投进积水，像一串串安静的铜号。高楼的窗大多黑着，只有便利店和急诊室亮着暖黄的光。洒水车缓缓驶过，留下柏油的气味；早点铺的蒸笼冒起白汽，葱香悄悄漫到巷口。偶尔有出租车驶过，尾灯闪了闪，消失在寂静里。天边泛出鱼肚白，清扫声沙沙响起，城市轻轻翻身，准备迎接新的一天。","w03":"- Recursion is when a task solves a smaller version of the exact same task.\n- It keeps calling itself with simpler inputs until it reaches a tiny, easy case called the base case.\n- Then the small answers pass back upward, like nested dolls opening until the smallest one tells the others what to do."}
